proposition: GET /v1/vulnerability/component/{uuid}: contract says pagination parameters select the page and number of component vulnerabilities returned; implementation does the DAO query selects all matching vulnerabilities without offset or limit and the handler returns the entire result
GET /tyk/keys: contract says the successful response is an array of key identifiers; implementation does the successful response is a JSON object containing a keys array

POST /parameter-contexts/{contextId}/update-requests: contract says updating a parameter context requires read permission for current and newly inherited parameter contexts; implementation does the update authorization callback checks the context, affected components and service references without checking inherited-context read permission

HEAD /api/verify: contract says HTTP 200 denotes successful permission verification and HTTP 401 denotes unauthorized access; implementation does a malformed original URL invokes an error reply without setting a non-success HTTP status

GET /api/v3/fs/disk: contract says the listing operation path ends in a trailing slash; implementation does the listing handler is registered without that slash, with slash-suffixed paths routed to GetFile

GET /api/v1/flags: contract says the enabled query parameter returns flags having the given enabled status; implementation does enabled=false is stored in a zero-valued struct field that the vendored query builder omits from SQL predicates
GET /sitemap.html: contract says the declared response media type is text/plain; implementation does the handler resolves an HTML template through a view resolver configured to emit text/html
DELETE /tyk/org/keys/{keyID}: contract says the organisation key operation is under /tyk/orgs/keys/{keyID}; implementation does the router registers the operation under /tyk/org/keys/{keyName}

PATCH /admin/api/v2/realms/{name}/clients/{id}: contract says displayName, appUrl and appRedirectUrls carry the client name, application homepage and redirect URLs; implementation does the DTO-to-model mapper has no mappings from those renamed fields to name, baseUrl and redirectUris, so submitted values are not transferred
GET /api/positions: contract says the returned Position network property is a string; implementation does Position exposes a Network bean that serializes as a JSON object

POST /api/v2/chat/stream: contract says message is a required string with no stated maximum length; implementation does messages above the configured character limit return 400, with a default limit of 4000

DELETE /engines/acp/ory/{flavor}/roles/{id}/members/{member}: contract says member removal uses the role members collection path with members supplied in a request body; implementation does the router requires an additional member path segment and the handler reads that path parameter

GET /api/v1/suggest-words: contract says suggestion metadata fields are named took, total and num, with item field values under field; implementation does the JSON writer emits query_time, record_count and page_size, with item values under labels

GET /engines/acp/ory/{flavor}/roles: contract says the successful response is a JSON array; implementation does empty filtered results remain nil slices passed to the JSON response writer, yielding null instead of an empty array
GET /api/reports/route: contract says the returned Position network property is a string; implementation does Position exposes a Network bean that serializes as a JSON object
GET /api/v1/albums/{uid}/links: contract says a single entity.Link object; implementation does a JSON array of share links

GET /registry/{registry_ref}/artifact/{artifact}/version/{version}/details: contract says a missing requested resource is reported as HTTP 404; implementation does a missing image lookup is translated to a resource-not-found error but the handler returns a typed HTTP 500 response

DELETE /engines/acp/ory/{flavor}/policies/{id}: contract says the documented policy flavors are regex and exact; implementation does the flavor parser also accepts glob through the existing EnabledFlavors list

DELETE /flowfile-queues/{id}/listing-requests/{listing-request-id}: contract says the successful response is documented using DropRequestEntity; implementation does the resource returns the structurally different ListingRequestEntity envelope
